kingdom-of-hungary_1147: shape unchanged, years 1147-1163 ('This shape holds to 1163'). The window agent's systemic finding stands: many keyframe_review entries whose notes limit their years have no from/to, so the compiler gives them their whole Cliopatria row and unions them with later keyframes. The rest of its list (paramara-dynasty_1111, eastern-kara-khanids_1126, kingdom-of-castile_1152, duchy-of-masovia_1147/_1169, kingdom-of-aragon_1126, danishmendids_1169, county-of-edessa_1139, county-of-flanders_1188, holy-roman-empire_1152/_1177, kamarupa-kingdom_1072, eastern-ganga-kingdom_1056, fatimid-caliphate_1099/_1111/_1152) is left for a dossier-wide fix.
